Book Recommender System - Academic Team Project (IIITD)
Feb 2024 - May 2024
- Designed and evaluated content-based, collaborative filtering, and hybrid recommendation models on the Book-Crossing dataset (271K+ books, 279K+ users, 1.15M+ ratings) as part of a 6-member team.

- Deployed the recommendation engine as an interactive Streamlit application with a feedback loop that dynamically re-weighted similarity scores based on user ratings.
